notes: Replace all zero values with values exported from CAD or measured.
Each component's reference frame origin is at its primary shaft or bearing axis, with x as the rotation axis.
Define the joint frame y and z directions consistently; the rotation axis alone does not define the full frame.
For driveUnit and mainAxis, inertia_about_rotation_axis_kg_m2 is the inertia about the stated reference-frame x axis, not about the COM.
Use center-of-mass offsets for components whose translation or gravity effects are modeled; they are omitted for these single-axis entries.
Replace placeholder values with CAD-exported or measured values.
